metadata.summary: Former Formula 1 world champion Damon Hill has insisted Ferrari should back the "extraordinary" Lewis Hamilton over his team-mate Charles Leclerc if they want to have a chance of winning next year's drivers' title.

Former Formula 1 world champion Damon Hill has insisted Ferrari should back the "extraordinary" Lewis Hamilton over his team-mate Charles Leclerc if they want to have a chance of winning next year's drivers' title. Ferrari's handling of their drivers came under increased scrutiny earlier this month following the Mexico City Grand Prix when a first-lap clash between Hamilton and Leclerc, running in first and second respectively at the time, cost the Italian team a likely one-two, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen going on to win the race. messages.text: Reynolds: Fearless Love can lead Packers to Super Bowl

metadata.summary: I'm well aware that we've only reached the halfway point of the 2026 season and so much can change in the NFL, especially at the back end of the year.
metadata.content: Jordan Love: Green Bay Packers quarterback is fearless and can lead Matt LaFleur's team to Super Bowl, says Neil Reynolds | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Jordan Love: Green Bay Packers quarterback is fearless and can lead Matt LaFleur's team to Super Bowl, says Neil Reynolds Sky Sports NFL's Neil Reynolds hails the form of Jordan Love and the Green Bay Packers in his weekly column; the Packers improved to 6-3 on the year on Sunday with a dominant win over the New England Patriots to continue their march towards the NFL playoffs Neil Reynolds American Football Expert & Columnist Tuesday 10 November 2026 15:33, UK I'm well aware that we've only reached the halfway point of the 2026 season and so much can change in the NFL, especially at the back end of the year. But I'm now starting to believe the Green Bay Packers can make a serious run and they have emerged as true contenders in the NFC. Sunday's 45-27 win over the New England Patriots in Foxborough was a statement victory and it was a win that showed the Packers to be a complete team. Jordan Love is playing as well as any quarterback in the NFL this season and he backed it up on Sunday on a big stage in a game being called by Tom Brady as he threw for 372 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions. The race was great, perhaps only missing a late surprise or crescendo. I must first congratulate the whole Mercedes Benz team, car and power unit combined, for once again winning the Constructors' Championship for a ninth time as a team. A tally which draws team boss Toto Wolff level with Sir Frank Willams as the most in F1 history, and with a further eight Mercedes drivers' titles on his watch, equalling Sir Ron Dennis' combined total of 17 as team principal. messages.text: England focused on Curry and Feyi-Waboso winning World Cup fitness race

metadata.summary: Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry will be carefully managed between now and the World Cup as England look to give two key personnel the best possible chance of being available for the tournament.
metadata.content: England focused on ensuring Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry get fit for Rugby World Cup | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England focused on ensuring Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry get fit for Rugby World Cup Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry have been laid low by injury and England are now focused on ensuring they will be fit for next year's Rugby World Cup; Kevin Sinfield also addressed the report that came out that said there was a squad rift in England Tuesday 10 November 2026 22:00, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Kevin Sinfield brings updates on Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry's injury concerns. Immanuel Feyi-Waboso and Tom Curry will be carefully managed between now and the World Cup as England look to give two key personnel the best possible chance of being available for the tournament. Feyi-Waboso will miss the rest of the autumn because of an ankle injury sustained in Sunday's 44-22 mauling of Australia, robbing England of their most dangerous attacking threat. British and Irish Lions flanker Curry will sit out all four Nations Championship matches at Allianz Stadium this month after aggravating a long-standing hip condition in training last week.
